title.zh-TW: 雲端工作階段裡的 `claude -p` 不再誤報沒登入
title.en: `claude -p` in cloud sessions no longer falsely reports "Not logged in"

body.zh-TW: 明明登入好了，腳本卻回你「Not logged in」，很容易讓人摸不著頭緒。這發生在雲端工作階段裡另外執行 `claude -p`（不開互動畫面、直接回一次答案）時：只要沒帶上該工作階段的環境變數，就會這樣誤報。現在不會了。
body.en: Running `claude -p` (which answers once without opening the interactive screen) inside a cloud session without that session's environment variables used to report "Not logged in", as if you had never signed in. It no longer does.

items.original: Fixed `claude -p` inside cloud sessions reporting "Not logged in" when started without the session's environment variables

title.zh-TW: 接很多 MCP 工具時，API 錯誤不再被誤報成對話太長
title.en: With many MCP tools, API errors are no longer mislabeled as "prompt is too long"

body.zh-TW: 明明才聊幾句，畫面卻說「prompt is too long」，你可能以為得開新對話了。這發生在接了很多 MCP 工具（讓 Claude 連外部服務的擴充）的工作階段：碰到 API 錯誤時，錯誤訊息會被換成這句。它還會順手做一次不必要的 compaction（把舊對話濃縮成摘要）。現在你看到的是原本的 API 錯誤，對話也不會白白被壓縮。
body.en: In sessions with many MCP tools (extensions that connect Claude to outside services), an API error used to show up as "prompt is too long", making you think the conversation had grown too long. It also triggered an unneeded compaction (condensing older conversation into a summary). Now you see the original API error, and your conversation is not compacted for nothing.

items.original: Fixed an API error being replaced by "prompt is too long", and an unneeded compaction, in sessions with many MCP tools
